costTracking.method: Append costObservations per completed run; preserve earlier observations. Record credits separately from input, cached input and output tokens.
costTracking.credits: Record operator or billing evidence and whether approximate. Never convert tokens to credits without a verified applicable rate.
costTracking.tokens: Use completed-run session usage: sum per-response usage exactly once by response_id, bounded by selected turn IDs. Do not sum cumulative turn/thread totals. Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning output.
costTracking.unavailable: Use null with a reason when unavailable; no estimates.
costTracking.reports: Include cost observations and their scope in run reports. Late data supplements a completed record through a new record; do not rewrite DONE records.
